jobs.title: Java Developer- Senior Associate- Financial Services
jobs.description:
Job Description
Why This Role Matters
Publicis Sapient is looking for a Senior Java Developer to join our team of bright thinkers and doers. In this role, you will leverage your technical expertise, creativity, and problem-solving skills to design and deliver innovative solutions for complex business challenges across multiple industries.
As part of our engineering team, you will contribute to building modern, scalable, and high-performing applications while collaborating with talented professionals in a fast-paced and agile environment. You will play a key role in shaping technical solutions and driving engineering excellence.
This role is an excellent opportunity for someone who would like to join an international global organization with a start-up mentality. We highly value Openness, Collaboration, Learning Mindset and partner with our clients to drive positive outcomes.
Where You’ll Make an Impact
Design, develop, test, and maintain Java-based applications and services.
Build scalable, secure, and highly available systems using modern Java frameworks and technologies.
Lead technical design discussions and contribute to architecture decisions.
Present technical solutions and effectively interact with stakeholders at different levels.
Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code, including unit, integration, and automated tests.
Optimize application performance, reliability, scalability, and security.
Perform code reviews and mentor junior and mid-level engineers.
Collaborate closely with Product Managers, QA Engineers, DevOps teams, and other stakeholders.
Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.
Investigate and provide root cause analysis for complex production issues.
Promote engineering best practices and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
What You’ll Bring To The Team
Strong experience developing enterprise applications using Java.
Solid hands-on experience with Spring Framework, Spring Boot, and building reusable Spring Boot starters and libraries.
Strong understanding of microservices architecture, including service discovery, circuit breakers, centralized logging, and containerization.
Experience developing and integrating REST and SOAP web services.
Experience with persistence frameworks such as Hibernate and JPA.
Proficiency with relational databases such as Oracle, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.
Knowledge of NoSQL databases such as MongoDB or Cassandra.
Experience with cloud platforms such as GCP, Azure or AWS knowledge is considered a nice-to-have.
Experience with CI/CD and build tools including Maven, Gradle, Jenkins, GitLab, and Docker.
Experience with messaging technologies such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or JMS.
Strong understanding of RESTful APIs and distributed systems.
Experience with automated testing using JUnit, Mockito, Testcontainers, integration testing, and end-to-end testing.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Professional proficiency in English.
Additional Experience We Value
Knowledge of modern JavaScript frameworks such as Angular, React, or Vue.js.
Experience with Kubernetes (K8s) and container orchestration.
Contract testing and Test-Driven Development (TDD).
Familiarity with modern CI/CD practices and tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and GitLab CI.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.
Exposure to cloud-native application design and deployment patterns.
Additional Information
What You’ll Get in Return
A fast-paced tech environment
Continuous growth & learning
Open feedback culture
Room for own initiative & ideas
Transparency about results & strategy
Recognition & reward for hard work
Working with a flexible schedule
Medical subscription
Meal tickets
25 vacation days
Many others perks
Company Description
About Publicis Sapient
Most companies in the AI era do one of two things: they advise, or they sell you a tool. We do both. Publicis Sapient is a technology company that provides enterprise AI platforms and services, which means we build our own AI platforms
and
bring the strategists, product thinkers, designers and engineers who make them work inside the world s most complex businesses. It is where people and products shape the future of enterprise, and where your ideas actually reach the organizations that run the world. If you want to question how things are done, learn continuously and do the best work of your career alongside 20,000 people across 28 countries, you re in the right place. Come build with us.
Our Commitment to Inclusive Hiring
We are committed to fostering and encouraging an inclusive and welcoming environment for everyone and we believe great talent comes from many different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. That is why we are committed to creating a hiring process where everyone has an equal opportunity to succeed and feel safe. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and identities including: race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or religion and value the diverse experiences, perspectives, and strengths they bring to our teams.
If there is anything we can do to make our recruitment process more accessible or comfortable for you, please let us know. We are happy to provide reasonable adjustments throughout the application and interview process. You can contact us anytime at emeahiringteam@publicissapient.com
Your Safety Matters To Us
At Publicis Sapient, we are committed to protecting candidates throughout every step of their journey with us. To help you stay safe from recruitment scams, please remember that our recruiters will only ever contact you from a Publicis Sapient email address. In some cases, we may partner with trusted, vetted recruitment agencies who will clearly identify themselves as working on behalf of Publicis Sapient. If you receive communication from any other domain claiming to represent us, please treat it with caution and contact us at emeahiringteam@publicissapient.com

jobs.title: Java Engineering Lead with German
jobs.description:
Who We Are
We don't have the fame, but we've got the flame. We are a distributed group of specialists within NTT DATA Romania, who make the best out of JVM-based technologies, creativity and business solutions. Referred to as Java Competence Center, we co-create and co-accelerate with key players in any field. In this role, you will: design and evolve scalable and resilient distributed systems; guide system integrations across complex environments and act as a bridge between business stakeholders and engineering teams, translating requirements into robust architectural solutions. You will operate at the intersection of technology, business, and regulation, shaping architectures that must be both flexible and audit-ready in a highly regulated environment. Documentation: Maintain clear architectural documentation, including design decisions and system landscapes
Quality & Governance: Establish best practices for architecture, code quality, testing, and deployment across the lifecycle
What You'll Bring Along
A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience
Around 10 years of experience in software engineering, with a strong focus on architecture and system design
Proven expertise in software, cloud, IT system, microservices, and solution architecture
Strong understanding of cloud-native and distributed systems design principles
Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and modern deployment practices
Knowledge of messaging technologies (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ)
Experience with build and CI/CD tools (e.g., Maven, automation pipelines)
Solid experience with databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL)
Familiarity with testing strategies and automation
Strong communication skills in English and German, with the ability to act as a bridge between teams
Ability to work independently and manage complex architectural challenges efficiently

jobs.title: Java Software Engineer | Marine Cloud
jobs.description:
At Garmin we create products that are designed indoors for outdoor activities. We do this to enable our customers to make the most of their time spent pursuing their passions.
We recognize the value of flexibility in supporting employee well-being, work-life balance, and effective collaboration. Associates may work from home up to four days per month, or one day per week, while remaining connected to the teams and culture that help us do our best work.
Our roles are primarily office-based because we believe the best ideas, innovation, and strongest professional relationships are built through in-person collaboration, making regular team interaction an important part of our culture and future success.
We are a global company with offices in the US, Europe and Asia. In these centers, we carry out the various stages of product development, from initial concept to mass production of ready-to-sell units. We embrace a vertically integrated business model with strategic design, manufacturing, distribution, sales and support centers around the world to maximize our value to customers.
Currently we have an opening for the following project:
Garmin Marine Cloud
: Our team develops software solutions for Garmin Marine, the platform for tracking, monitoring, and navigating marine environments using data gathered from our advanced marine devices. The Marine ecosystem relies on complex technical solutions with multiple microservices working together to process, categorize, and utilize information provided by marine chartplotters, fishfinders, autopilot systems, radar, marine charts, and other marine electronics. These solutions ensure seamless integration and performance, empowering users to navigate safely and efficiently while enjoying their time on the water. Our innovative products and solutions have been recognized with multiple awards from the National Marine Electronics Association (NMEA), underscoring our commitment to excellence and leadership in marine technology.
Joining this team, you will:
Develop software for Garmin products and/or applications consistently following Garmin's coding standards and in accordance with applicable software development methodology and release processes
Utilize software engineering tools such as configuration management systems, build processes, and debuggers in the software development process
Create and execute designs for small sets of new functionalities as part of a software project
Collaborate and add value through participation in peer code reviews, providing comments and suggestions
Provide reliable solutions to a variety of problems using sound problem solving techniques
Requirements
Strong knowledge of Java and OOP principles
Proficiency experience in designing, enhancing and developing complex Java microservices (Spring Boot) or cloud-native applications
Skilled in Spring Framework
Good knowledge of web services (REST)
Knowledgeable about relational or non-relational databases
Good understanding of design patterns
Skilled in unit testing
Good usage skills of development tools (source control, development environment, issue tracking)
Good knowledge of building tools and continuous delivery
5+ years of relevant work experience
Excellent English speaking and writing skills
Would be a plus, if you:
Have experience with .NET, JS
Knowledge and experience with AKS/Kubernetes
Familiar with Azure or AWS
Benefits
Benefits to enhance your experience:
24 days off each year plus extra vacation days based on years at Garmin and compensation for legal holidays
Health package subscription and yearly budget for glasses
Monthly budget for sports and wellbeing activities
Local and global career development programs (training, mentorship, technical and leadership development, and more)
Access to e-learning platforms and support for technical conferences attendance
Loyalty bonus within the company, plus other special bonuses (for holidays and personal life events)
Meal tickets
Yours exclusively when part of our team:
Significant discount for Garmin products
Employee stock purchase plan
Contribution to the retirement plan (Pillar 3)
Garmin products available for testing and borrowing
A comprehensive event series championing wellbeing, sports, and community tailored to foster holistic health (featuring sports events, classes, hackathons, parties, and more)
Other benefits which we invite you to discover along the recruitment process
Garmin Cluj is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, national origin, sex, age or disability.
